text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What the hell! What is going on with 
Japanese racing?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To be swept up like rough waves and 
shipwrecked in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm completely sure of it, Trainer! A 
fortune is sleeping at the end of this 
road!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That is why! Everyone is driven by the 
romance of it all, clashing their burning 
passions together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Truly a Golden Road! Ah, I can hardly 
wait for the next race!!"
choice_data_list: With that mindset, you'll win next time!

Let's make sure we prepare properly to 
win, too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! If we run aground, we just fix the 
ship and row out once more!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's bring you into peak condition, one 
that won't budge no matter the storm!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! Next time, I'll conquer the 
rough waves and seize glory!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Charging forward blindly will 
only lead to running aground again—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've got my trusty Navigator with 
me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's search for the golden path— 
Together, the two of us are sure to find 
it!
